scope: All 13 manifest replacement records (12 MSK and one renal-HD timing), source context and triad equivalence. Not global scientific approval.
compiledCardCheck: Two pediatric flashcard EN/FA answers verified in actual compiled exports; not assumed to appear in lesson SSR.
notes: Patella: all three corrected German image descriptions independently compared with actual EN/FA triples; same Wiberg I–III, transverse/longitudinal/comminuted patterns, medial patellar facet/lateral femoral condyle sites and non-diagnostic/not-to-scale qualifications. Correct DE strings present in actual SSR alt attributes.
Open fracture: FA now explicitly preserves both neither proves nor excludes, with clinical definition and gas/foreign-body warning signs. Equivalent to existing DE/EN negation.

Pediatric periosteum: fracture-fragment displacement replaces joint dislocation in EN/FA body and compiled flashcard index 10 answer. Hinge, osteoprogenitor/callus/healing clauses retained. Helps prevent is appropriately nonabsolute; German Dislokation here refers to fracture displacement.
Forearm: FA risk of permanent pronosupination loss restores DE droht/EN may-result modality rather than deterministic outcome. Length, axis, rotation and radial bow context unchanged.

Renal HD: FA explicitly each of the following two days now equals DE an den zwei Folgetagen and EN on the following two days. Existing-HD-only boundary, macrocyclic-versus-linear distinction and ACR comparison retained. This is linguistic verification, not independent recertification of the contrasted guideline recommendations.

Fracture-source table: page-local L is a localized-object picker, so passing object plus lang is correct. All three headings now present in appropriate DE/EN/FA actual SSR (nine strings); no generic string object fallback remains for these cells.
